title: Keto Friendly Australian Hind Shank Wrap
description: A salty, molten, and festive Australian dish featuring hind shank, served in a pandan-leaf wrap, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Season the hind shank with salt, black pepper, and garlic.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Sear the hind shank until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lemon juice to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the hind shank to the pot, cover, and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the hind shank for 2.5 hours, or until tender and falling off the bone.
While the hind shank is cooking, prepare the pandan leaves by washing and trimming the stems.
To assemble the wraps, slice the cooked hind shank into thin strips.
Place a few strips of the hind shank onto the center of a pandan leaf, then fold the leaf to enclose.
